'''Mohamed Diawara''' (born 29 April 2005)<ref name=":0">{{cite web |url=https://parisbasketball.paris/joueur/mohamed-diawara/# |title=Mohamed Diawara |work=Paris Basketball |access-date=2022-10-06}}</ref> is a French professional [[basketball]] player for [[Cholet Basket]] of the [[LNB Élite]]. Standing at {{height|ft=6|in=8}}, he plays in the [[power forward]] position.

==Professional career==
Diawara began his basketball career with the Parisian club La Domremy Basket 13 and later played for the youth team of Saint Charles Basket in Charenton-le-Pont.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.saintcharlesbasket.fr/articles/56649-decouvrez-mohamed-diawara |title=Découvrez Mohamed Diawara |work=Saint Charles Basket |date=2020 |access-date=2022-10-06}}</ref> In the 2020–21 season, he was trained at the French academy [[INSEP]]<ref name=":0" /> and moved to [[Paris Basketball]] in the summer of 2021,<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{cite web |url=https://basket-ballworld.fr/paris-basketball-ambitions/ |title=Elite : Le Paris Basketball affiche ses ambitions |work=basket-ballworld.fr |date=2021-09-25 |access-date=2022-10-06}}</ref> for which he made his first appearances in the French first division in the following 2021–22 season.<ref name=":0" /> In the summer of 2022, he was named the best player at the [[Basketball Without Borders]] talent scouting event organized by the world governing body [[FIBA]] ​​and the [[National Basketball Association|NBA]] in [[Milan]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bebasket.fr/mohamed-diawara-et-leila-lacan-deux-francais-mvp-du-basketball-without-borders-europe/ |title=Mohamed Diawara et Leila Lacan : deux Français MVP du Basketball Without Borders Europe |work=BeBasket |date=2022-06-05 |access-date=2022-10-06}}</ref>

In December 2023, Diawara was loaned to second-division club [[Poitiers Basket 86]],<ref>{{cite web |url=https://parisbasketball.com/2023/12/diawara-prete-a-poitiers-jusqua-la-fin-de-saison/ |title=Diawara prêté à Poitiers jusqu'à la fin de saison |work=Paris Basketball |date=2023-12-20 |language=fr |access-date=2024-04-23}}</ref> after receiving little playing time in Paris during the previous 2023–24 season. He was signed by first-division club [[Cholet Basket]] during the 2024 summer break.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bebasket.fr/avec-cholet-mohamed-diawara-va-vouloir-montrer-quil-a-les-epaules-pour-la-nba |title=Avec Cholet, Mohamed Diawara va vouloir montrer qu'il a les épaules pour la NBA |work=Bebasket.fr |date=2024-09-13 |language=fr |access-date=2024-09-13}}</ref>

==National team career==
Diawara played for the [[France men's national under-17 basketball team|France under-17 basketball team]] at the [[2022 FIBA Under-17 Basketball World Cup]], in which his team won the bronze medal.<ref>{{cite web |date=10 July 2022 |title=Les Bleuets décrochent le bronze à la Coupe du monde U17 contre la Lituanie |url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Les-bleuets-decrochent-le-bronze-a-la-coupe-du-monde-u17-contre-la-lituanie/1342989 |access-date=23 February 2023 |work=[[L'Équipe]] |language=fr}}</ref>
